import os, sys, json as _json, socket, struct, secrets, hashlib, time, hmac
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.kdf.hkdf import HKDF
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.utils import encode_dss_signature

TCTI = os.environ.get("TPM_TCTI", "swtpm:path=/tmp/tpm/swtpm.sock")
HOST = os.environ.get("HS_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
PORT = int(os.environ.get("HS_PORT", "30303"))
PCR  = int(os.environ.get("HS_PCR", "23"))
SELF_PATH = os.path.realpath(__file__)

# ---- this node's identity ----
ME       = "__NODE" "1"     # this node's id
PEER     = "__NODE" "2"     # peer's id
PEER_SRC = __NODE2      # peer's reconstructed source code

# length-prefixed JSON over TCP
def _recvn(sock, n):
    buf = b""
    while len(buf) < n:
        c = sock.recv(n - len(buf))
        if not c:
            raise ConnectionError("peer closed")
        buf += c
    return buf

def _send(sock, obj):
    b = _json.dumps(obj).encode()
    sock.sendall(struct.pack(">I", len(b)) + b)

def _recv(sock):
    n = struct.unpack(">I", _recvn(sock, 4))[0]
    return _json.loads(_recvn(sock, n).decode())

def rendezvous():
    # this node listens; the peer dials in
    srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    srv.bind((HOST, PORT)); srv.listen(1)
    print("[%s] listening on %s:%d" % (ME, HOST, PORT), flush=True)
    conn, _ = srv.accept()
    return conn

def self_measure():
    # hash own deployed file
    with open(SELF_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        return hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()

def expected_pcr(ref_hex):
    # replay: reset(0), extend own-code digest
    v = bytes(32)
    v = hashlib.sha256(v + bytes.fromhex(ref_hex)).digest()
    return v

def tpm_attest(self_ref_hex, eph_pub, peer_nonce):
    from tpm2_pytss import ESAPI
    from tpm2_pytss.constants import (TPM2_SU, TPM2_ALG, TPM2_ECC, TPMA_OBJECT, ESYS_TR)
    from tpm2_pytss.types import (TPM2B_PUBLIC, TPMT_PUBLIC, TPMU_PUBLIC_PARMS,
        TPMS_ECC_PARMS, TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT, TPMT_ECC_SCHEME, TPMU_ASYM_SCHEME,
        TPMS_SCHEME_HASH, TPMT_KDF_SCHEME, TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE,
        TPML_DIGEST_VALUES, TPMT_HA, TPMU_HA, TPML_PCR_SELECTION,
        TPMT_SIG_SCHEME, TPM2B_DATA)
    from tpm2_pytss.TSS2_Exception import TSS2_Exception

    ectx = ESAPI(TCTI)
    handle = None
    try:
        try:
            ectx.startup(TPM2_SU.CLEAR)
        except TSS2_Exception:
            pass

        # create ECDSA attestation key
        ak_tmpl = TPM2B_PUBLIC(publicArea=TPMT_PUBLIC(
            type=TPM2_ALG.ECC, nameAlg=TPM2_ALG.SHA256,
            objectAttributes=(TPMA_OBJECT.FIXEDTPM | TPMA_OBJECT.FIXEDPARENT
                              | TPMA_OBJECT.SENSITIVEDATAORIGIN
                              | TPMA_OBJECT.USERWITHAUTH | TPMA_OBJECT.SIGN_ENCRYPT),
            parameters=TPMU_PUBLIC_PARMS(eccDetail=TPMS_ECC_PARMS(
                symmetric=TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT(algorithm=TPM2_ALG.NULL),
                scheme=TPMT_ECC_SCHEME(scheme=TPM2_ALG.ECDSA,
                    details=TPMU_ASYM_SCHEME(
                        ecdsa=TPMS_SCHEME_HASH(hashAlg=TPM2_ALG.SHA256))),
                curveID=TPM2_ECC.NIST_P256,
                kdf=TPMT_KDF_SCHEME(scheme=TPM2_ALG.NULL)))))
        handle, ak_pub, _, _, _ = ectx.create_primary(TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE(), ak_tmpl)

        pcr_tr = getattr(ESYS_TR, "PCR%d" % PCR, PCR)
        ectx.pcr_reset(pcr_tr)

        def extend(dg):
            vals = TPML_DIGEST_VALUES([TPMT_HA(hashAlg=TPM2_ALG.SHA256, digest=TPMU_HA(sha256=dg))])
            ectx.pcr_extend(pcr_tr, vals)

        extend(bytes.fromhex(self_ref_hex))        # extend its own code

        sel = TPML_PCR_SELECTION.parse("sha256:%d" % PCR)
        _, _, pcr_digests = ectx.pcr_read(sel)
        pcr_value = bytes(pcr_digests[0])

        # quote with qualifying data = sha256(ephemeral_pubkey || peer nonce)
        qual = hashlib.sha256(eph_pub + peer_nonce).digest()
        quoted, sig = ectx.quote(handle, sel, TPM2B_DATA(qual),
                                 TPMT_SIG_SCHEME(scheme=TPM2_ALG.NULL))
        return (bytes(ak_pub.marshal()), pcr_value,
                bytes(quoted.marshal()), bytes(sig.marshal()))
    finally:
        if handle is not None:
            try:
                ectx.flush_context(handle)
            except Exception:
                pass
        ectx.close()

def verify_quote(ak_pub_b, pcr_value_b, quoted_b, sig_b, my_nonce, peer_ref_hex, peer_eph):
    from tpm2_pytss.types import TPM2B_PUBLIC, TPMS_ATTEST, TPMT_SIGNATURE
    from tpm2_pytss.constants import TPM2_GENERATED, TPM2_ST

    exp_pcr = expected_pcr(peer_ref_hex)                 # recalculated PCR from peer ref
    print("[%s] peer ref (self-computed): %s" % (ME, peer_ref_hex), flush=True)
    print("[%s] peer AK hash (received) : %s" % (ME, hashlib.sha256(ak_pub_b).hexdigest()), flush=True)
    print("[%s] PCR%d recalculated      : %s" % (ME, PCR, exp_pcr.hex()), flush=True)
    print("[%s] PCR%d received          : %s" % (ME, PCR, pcr_value_b.hex()), flush=True)

    size = struct.unpack(">H", quoted_b[:2])[0]
    signed = quoted_b[2:2 + size]

    akpub = TPM2B_PUBLIC.unmarshal(ak_pub_b)[0]
    sig = TPMT_SIGNATURE.unmarshal(sig_b)[0]
    r = int.from_bytes(bytes(sig.signature.ecdsa.signatureR), "big")
    s = int.from_bytes(bytes(sig.signature.ecdsa.signatureS), "big")
    try:
        pk = serialization.load_pem_public_key(akpub.to_pem())
    except Exception:
        x = int.from_bytes(bytes(akpub.publicArea.unique.ecc.x), "big")
        y = int.from_bytes(bytes(akpub.publicArea.unique.ecc.y), "big")
        pk = ec.EllipticCurvePublicNumbers(x, y, ec.SECP256R1()).public_key()
    pk.verify(encode_dss_signature(r, s), signed, ec.ECDSA(hashes.SHA256()))   # verify signature

    att = TPMS_ATTEST.unmarshal(signed)[0]
    assert int(att.magic) == int(TPM2_GENERATED.VALUE)
    assert int(att.type) == int(TPM2_ST.ATTEST_QUOTE)
    assert bytes(att.extraData) == hashlib.sha256(peer_eph + my_nonce).digest()  # freshness (nonce) + ephemeral key binding

    assert pcr_value_b == exp_pcr
    assert bytes(att.attested.quote.pcrDigest) == hashlib.sha256(exp_pcr).digest()
    return True

def main():
    eph_priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    eph_pub = eph_priv.public_key().public_bytes(
        serialization.Encoding.DER, serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)
    my_nonce = secrets.token_bytes(32)

    self_ref = self_measure()                                            # own measurement (from disk)
    peer_ref = hashlib.sha256(PEER_SRC.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()      # peer reference (sha256 of embedded code)

    sock = rendezvous()
    _send(sock, {"nonce": my_nonce.hex(), "eph": eph_pub.hex()})
    r1 = _recv(sock)
    peer_nonce = bytes.fromhex(r1["nonce"]); peer_eph = bytes.fromhex(r1["eph"])

    ak, pcr, quoted, sig = tpm_attest(self_ref, eph_pub, peer_nonce)
    _send(sock, {"ak": ak.hex(), "pcr": pcr.hex(), "quoted": quoted.hex(), "sig": sig.hex()})
    r2 = _recv(sock)

    try:
        verify_quote(bytes.fromhex(r2["ak"]), bytes.fromhex(r2["pcr"]),
                     bytes.fromhex(r2["quoted"]), bytes.fromhex(r2["sig"]),
                     my_nonce, peer_ref, peer_eph)
        print("[%s] peer %s : ATTESTATION VERIFIED" % (ME, PEER), flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print("[%s] peer %s : ATTESTATION FAILED (%s)" % (ME, PEER, e), flush=True)
        sock.close(); sys.exit(1)

    # mutually-attested ECDH session
    shared = eph_priv.exchange(ec.ECDH(), serialization.load_der_public_key(peer_eph))
    key = HKDF(algorithm=hashes.SHA256(), length=32, salt=None, info=b"mutual-attest-poc").derive(shared)
    print("[%s] session key established: %s..." % (ME, key.hex()[:32]), flush=True)
    msg = ("hello from " + ME).encode()
    _send(sock, {"msg": msg.hex(), "tag": hmac.new(key, msg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()})
    pm = _recv(sock)
    pmsg = bytes.fromhex(pm["msg"])
    ok = hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(key, pmsg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(), pm["tag"])
    print("[%s] peer says: %r (MAC %s)" % (ME, pmsg.decode("utf-8", "replace"), "ok" if ok else "BAD"), flush=True)
    sock.close()

main()

PORT = int(os.environ.get("HS_PORT", "30303"))
PCR  = int(os.environ.get("HS_PCR", "23"))
SELF_PATH = os.path.realpath(__file__)

# ---- this node's identity ----
ME       = "__NODE" "2"     # this node's id
PEER     = "__NODE" "1"     # peer's id
PEER_SRC = __NODE1      # peer's reconstructed source code

# length-prefixed JSON over TCP
def _recvn(sock, n):

    n = struct.unpack(">I", _recvn(sock, 4))[0]
    return _json.loads(_recvn(sock, n).decode())

def rendezvous():
    # this node dials in to the peer's listening socket
    deadline = time.time() + 30
    while True:
        try:
            s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
            s.connect((HOST, PORT))
            return s
        except OSError:
            if time.time() > deadline:
                raise
            time.sleep(0.3)

    with open(SELF_PATH, "rb") as fh:

        TPMS_SCHEME_HASH, TPMT_KDF_SCHEME, TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE,
        TPML_DIGEST_VALUES, TPMT_HA, TPMU_HA, TPML_PCR_SELECTION,
        TPMT_SIG_SCHEME, TPM2B_DATA)

        ak_tmpl = TPM2B_PUBLIC(publicArea=TPMT_PUBLIC(
            type=TPM2_ALG.ECC, nameAlg=TPM2_ALG.SHA256,
            objectAttributes=(TPMA_OBJECT.FIXEDTPM | TPMA_OBJECT.FIXEDPARENT
                              | TPMA_OBJECT.SENSITIVEDATAORIGIN
                              | TPMA_OBJECT.USERWITHAUTH | TPMA_OBJECT.SIGN_ENCRYPT),
            parameters=TPMU_PUBLIC_PARMS(eccDetail=TPMS_ECC_PARMS(

                scheme=TPMT_ECC_SCHEME(scheme=TPM2_ALG.ECDSA,
                    details=TPMU_ASYM_SCHEME(
                        ecdsa=TPMS_SCHEME_HASH(hashAlg=TPM2_ALG.SHA256))),

            ectx.pcr_extend(pcr_tr, vals)

        _, _, pcr_digests = ectx.pcr_read(sel)

                                 TPMT_SIG_SCHEME(scheme=TPM2_ALG.NULL))
        return (bytes(ak_pub.marshal()), pcr_value,
                bytes(quoted.marshal()), bytes(sig.marshal()))

        if handle is not None:
            try:
                ectx.flush_context(handle)
            except Exception:

def verify_quote(ak_pub_b, pcr_value_b, quoted_b, sig_b, my_nonce, peer_ref_hex, peer_eph):
    from tpm2_pytss.types import TPM2B_PUBLIC, TPMS_ATTEST, TPMT_SIGNATURE
    from tpm2_pytss.constants import TPM2_GENERATED, TPM2_ST

    exp_pcr = expected_pcr(peer_ref_hex)                 # recalculated PCR from peer ref
    print("[%s] peer ref (self-computed): %s" % (ME, peer_ref_hex), flush=True)
    print("[%s] peer AK hash (received) : %s" % (ME, hashlib.sha256(ak_pub_b).hexdigest()), flush=True)
    print("[%s] PCR%d recalculated      : %s" % (ME, PCR, exp_pcr.hex()), flush=True)
    print("[%s] PCR%d received          : %s" % (ME, PCR, pcr_value_b.hex()), flush=True)

    size = struct.unpack(">H", quoted_b[:2])[0]
    signed = quoted_b[2:2 + size]

    akpub = TPM2B_PUBLIC.unmarshal(ak_pub_b)[0]
    sig = TPMT_SIGNATURE.unmarshal(sig_b)[0]
    r = int.from_bytes(bytes(sig.signature.ecdsa.signatureR), "big")
    s = int.from_bytes(bytes(sig.signature.ecdsa.signatureS), "big")
    try:
        pk = serialization.load_pem_public_key(akpub.to_pem())
    except Exception:
        x = int.from_bytes(bytes(akpub.publicArea.unique.ecc.x), "big")
        y = int.from_bytes(bytes(akpub.publicArea.unique.ecc.y), "big")
        pk = ec.EllipticCurvePublicNumbers(x, y, ec.SECP256R1()).public_key()

    assert bytes(att.extraData) == hashlib.sha256(peer_eph + my_nonce).digest()  # freshness (nonce) + ephemeral key binding

    assert pcr_value_b == exp_pcr
    assert bytes(att.attested.quote.pcrDigest) == hashlib.sha256(exp_pcr).digest()
    return True

def main():
    eph_priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    eph_pub = eph_priv.public_key().public_bytes(
        serialization.Encoding.DER, serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)
    my_nonce = secrets.token_bytes(32)

    self_ref = self_measure()                                            # own measurement (from disk)
    peer_ref = hashlib.sha256(PEER_SRC.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()      # peer reference (sha256 of embedded code)

    key = HKDF(algorithm=hashes.SHA256(), length=32, salt=None, info=b"mutual-attest-poc").derive(shared)
    print("[%s] session key established: %s..." % (ME, key.hex()[:32]), flush=True)
